headline.en: Make tool-call arguments match your harness.
headline.zh: 让工具参数匹配现有调用框架。

sub.en: glm-toolbridge converts supported GLM-style tool-call shapes into the OpenAI-compatible structures expected by a Python harness.
sub.zh: glm-toolbridge 将已支持的 GLM 风格工具调用形状转换成 Python 调用框架期望的 OpenAI 兼容结构。

body.en: Conversion stays outside your tool dispatch code.
body.zh: 转换逻辑集中在工具分发代码之外。

body.en: Sync, async and stream adapters share normalization.
body.zh: 同步、异步与流式适配共用归一化逻辑。
未支持形状产生明确命名的错误。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The included Python script defines a complete response with object arguments and prints the normalized message.
note.zh: 随仓 Python 脚本定义完整的对象参数响应，并打印归一化后的消息。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Synthetic native-object arguments converted through the production normalize_response function; no live GLM endpoint.

body.en: The included Python script defines a complete response with object arguments and prints the normalized message.
body.zh: 随仓 Python 脚本定义完整的对象参数响应，并打印归一化后的消息。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/glm-toolbridge.git
cd glm-toolbridge
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The demo uses a synthetic response. It does not establish the behavior of any current GLM deployment or compatibility with every agent harness.
limitations.zh: 示例使用合成响应，不代表当前 GLM 部署的实际行为，也不证明兼容所有 Agent 框架。

limitations.en: Only the supported OpenAI-style contract is adapted; Anthropic Messages is outside the current adapter.
limitations.zh: 当前只适配已支持的 OpenAI 风格契约，Anthropic Messages 不在此范围。

body.en: A tool dispatcher may expect arguments as a JSON string while a response contains an object. Keep that protocol conversion in one adapter so the tool dispatcher can continue using its established input contract.
body.zh: 工具分发器可能要求 arguments 为 JSON 字符串，而响应却给出对象。把协议转换集中到适配层，工具分发器便可沿用已有输入契约。

body.en: Request denormalization prepares tool definitions. Response normalization handles supported argument encoding, parallel-call and reasoning differences. Client wrappers apply the transformations to sync, async and streamed results, while explicit errors identify unsupported shapes.
body.zh: 请求转换准备工具定义；响应归一化处理已支持的参数编码、并行调用和推理字段差异。客户端包装器将转换应用于同步、异步和流式结果，未支持形状通过明确错误报告。

body.en: Request denormalization prepares tool definitions. Response normalization handles supported argument encoding, parallel-call and reasoning differences. Client wrappers apply the transformations to sync, async and streamed results, while explicit errors identify unsupported shapes.
body.zh: 请求转换准备工具定义；响应归一化处理已支持的参数编码、并行调用和推理字段差异。客户端包装器将转换应用于同步、异步和流式结果，未支持形状通过明确错误报告。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Use wrap(client) for a synchronous OpenAI client and awrap(client) for an async client. Configure the endpoint, model and credentials on the underlying client. Pure normalize_response and denormalize_request functions need no key.
body.zh: 同步 OpenAI 客户端使用 wrap(client)，异步客户端使用 awrap(client)。端点、模型和凭据在原客户端配置；纯函数 normalize_response 与 denormalize_request 无需密钥。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。
